survey_scope_note: Minimum number of congruent translations, rotations, and reflections of the fixed 11P1 polyomino that tile any axis-aligned rectangle.

best_human.ai_provenance: Published human construction. Polyominoes.org attributes its 54x55 rectangle to Michael Reid's 11-omino page; MIT Tiling Search identifies the 270-copy construction with a July 1997 Dahlke attribution via B. A. Wichmann. Local SVG extraction and certificate encoding used AI assistance.
best_human.evidence_state: The source SVG gives 270 D4-congruent placements. Exact verification confirms that they cover the 54x55 rectangle with no overlap. This is a feasible construction, not a proved minimum.
best_human.origin_type: published human construction, locally decoded and verified

best_public.ai_provenance: The cited construction is attributed to a July 1997 Dahlke record in the MIT archive. No AI provenance is indicated; the primary source is a 1997 human construction.
best_public.evidence_state: The exact public construction is replayed and verified at 270 copies. The modern polyominoes.org page labels its order <=270; no minimum-order proof was found.

best_reproduced.ai_provenance: The published SVG was decoded locally with AI assistance; the witness and score were independently recomputed by the exact checker.
best_reproduced.evidence_state: All 270 placements are D4 copies of the 11-cell tile. Their cells are pairwise disjoint and exactly cover the 54x55 rectangle.

T099-C01.optimality_status: Open in sources checked through 2026-11-06; source gives <=270 without a lower-bound proof.
